item.title: Why I Like Using CLIs — A Retrospective
item.description: I been using CLI and terminal as long as I been a software dev, at least as I know. You been seen some of the people in your like, who prefers to use CLIs over GUI. This sometimes look stupid, especially during these times where most of things can be done in a few clicks or so. what’s the point in just sticking with a terminal and typing commands. Even a person who has been using for years, actually don’t understand it until recently. There have been many misinterpretation of the beauty of CLI. This is just a blog post of me just expressing why I am using it over GUIs.

item.title: Linux File Permissions — The Magic of Restrictions Hidden in Plain Sight
item.description:
I think it’s been around 5 years, I switched to linux. I also try to understand linux deeply, through config, unix tools, using CLI tools and so on… But I never tried to truly understand how linux file permission works. when i want to execute a file, I always used:

chmod +x <script_file>

But recently I explored on how there permissions works and why is it important, and why one should learn about it
